entry_id.description: Identifier of the entry, answered by the entry endpoint, and the entity id of the bootstrap (identifiers.adoc, entry_id).

kind.description: Selects the bootstrap unit: bootstrap-plan or bootstrap-epic.

from_epic.description: kind plan only: the parent epic of a plan the server starts for a launchable epic row (never set by the operator's entry); the start.create-scope transaction copies it into mcp/status.json origin.epic_id.

state.description: Fully qualified state id of the bootstrap entity (for example start.sources, or source-issue.screen inside a called source unit).

call_stack.description: Call frames of a called source unit or chat (same frame shape as the Workflow State Store).

facts.description: State facts of the bootstrap (local listings, setup state, premise evidence, flagged spans).

recipe.description: The recipe chosen in start.choose, whose workflow becomes the plan's process; null for a plan from sources and for an epic.

params.description: The recipe's parameters, validated against its descriptor.

options.description: What start.ready or start-epic.ready shows, proposed from the sources: the slug that derives the id and the title. A recipe plan's id is derived from its recipe key and not changeable; its title is.

pending_condition.description: Condition overlay of the bootstrap entity (same shape as the Workflow State Store's pending_condition).

last_refusal.description: Reason of the last refused re-check of the start.create-scope transaction (for example plan_id_taken, lifecycle_closed, config_invalid, config_dirty, no_local_changes, lesson_unavailable); rendered in the facts of start.ready as commit_refused; null otherwise.
